provenance_limits: Asset paths and published subject identifiers are not independent-session or population-inference units.
Calendar dates are anonymized; preserve original subject/session/asset identities.
Pilot image membership resolves old/new labels as1=old,0=new despite reversed source description; all-asset verification is still required.
Common acquisition-clock seconds have arbitrary nonzero origin; do not subtract separate event/spike origins.
Units link to original microwires, not a measured peak-channel field.
Continuous observation coverage is not established by spike extrema; explicit observation intervals must be checked.
The exact exporter commit is not established by the retained historical author code.
